title: mekong-bankline-forecast: code for coverage-verified forecasts of riverbank retreat, Tien and Hau rivers, Vietnamese Mekong Delta

creators.name: Le, Trong Nghia
creators.affiliation: University of Economics Ho Chi Minh City (UEH)

description: Code, frozen analysis protocol and results for the manuscript "Coverage-verified forecasts of riverbank retreat and the limits of public erosion reports as hazard labels: Tien and Hau rivers, Vietnamese Mekong Delta" (in preparation for Natural Hazards and Earth System Sciences). It extracts annual dry-season banklines from Landsat and Sentinel-2 in Google Earth Engine, builds 2 km bank units, satellite and reported erosion labels and covariates, fits point forecasts and conformal prediction intervals, tests the label-source hypothesis, and runs the exploratory, robustness and post hoc analyses, figures, data release and interactive atlas. Data: doi:10.5281/zenodo.23665677.
